organizations.name: Bangladesh Police
organizations.parent: Public Security Division, Ministry of Home Affairs
organizations.description: National police force of Bangladesh; Police Headquarters publishes crime statistics by police unit.

organizations.name: Bangladesh Election Commission
organizations.description: Constitutional body that conducts national and local elections, maintains the voter list and delimits parliamentary constituencies.

organizations.name: Local Government Division
organizations.parent: Ministry of Local Government, Rural Development and Co-operatives
organizations.description: Government division responsible for city corporations, municipalities, zila, upazila and union parishads.

organizations.name: Local Government Engineering Department
organizations.description: Government department that plans, builds and maintains rural and urban local infrastructure such as upazila, union and village roads, bridges and markets.

organizations.name: Roads and Highways Department
organizations.parent: Road Transport and Highways Division, Ministry of Road Transport and Bridges
organizations.description: Government department responsible for the national, regional and zilla highway network and its bridges.

organizations.name: Bangladesh Road Transport Authority
organizations.parent: Road Transport and Highways Division, Ministry of Road Transport and Bridges
organizations.description: Regulator for motor vehicle registration, driving licences, fitness and route permits; publishes vehicle registration and road accident reports.

organizations.name: Bangladesh Telecommunication Regulatory Commission
organizations.description: Independent telecom regulator; publishes monthly mobile and internet subscriber, teledensity, tower and handset statistics.

organizations.name: Chittagong Port Authority
organizations.description: Statutory authority operating Chattogram Port, the country's main seaport; publishes cargo, container and vessel handling statistics.

organizations.name: Ministry of Railways
organizations.description: Ministry overseeing Bangladesh Railway; publishes the Railway Information Book.

organizations.name: Civil Aviation Authority of Bangladesh
organizations.parent: Ministry of Civil Aviation and Tourism
organizations.description: Civil aviation regulator and operator of Bangladesh's airports and air navigation services.

organizations.name: Ministry of Public Administration
organizations.description: Ministry responsible for civil service management; its Statistics and Research Cell publishes statistics of government servants.

organizations.name: Supreme Court of Bangladesh
organizations.description: Highest court of Bangladesh, comprising the Appellate Division and the High Court Division; publishes annual reports with case statistics.

organizations.name: Bureau of Manpower, Employment and Training
organizations.parent: Ministry of Expatriates' Welfare and Overseas Employment
organizations.description: Department that regulates recruitment and emigration clearance of Bangladeshi migrant workers and runs technical training centres; publishes overseas employment statistics.

organizations.name: Bangladesh Railway
organizations.description: State-owned and operated national railway, organised in East and West zones; publishes train timetables and fare information.

organizations.name: Bangladesh Inland Water Transport Authority
organizations.description: Authority established by ordinance in 1958 (as EPIWTA) to develop, maintain, operate and regulate inland water transport and navigable waterways; runs hydrography, dredging and river port functions.

organizations.name: Mongla Port Authority
organizations.description: Authority operating Mongla, Bangladesh's second seaport; its Traffic Department publishes vessel, cargo, container and vehicle handling statistics.

organizations.name: Anti-Corruption Commission
organizations.description: Independent commission that investigates and prosecutes corruption offences; publishes monthly case statistics and annual reports.

organizations.name: Bangladesh Public Service Commission
organizations.description: Constitutional commission that recruits officers to the civil service (BCS and non-cadre posts) and advises on public service matters; publishes annual reports.

organizations.name: Department of Inspection for Factories and Establishments
organizations.description: Labour inspectorate that licenses and inspects factories, shops and establishments for compliance with labour, safety and health law.

organizations.name: Dhaka Mass Transit Company Limited
organizations.description: Government-owned company that builds and operates the Dhaka Metro Rail (MRT) network (MRT lines).

organizations.name: Dhaka North City Corporation
organizations.description: City corporation governing northern Dhaka; publishes annual budgets and daily dengue situation reports.

organizations.name: Dhaka South City Corporation
organizations.description: City corporation governing southern Dhaka; publishes annual budgets and annual administrative reports.

organizations.name: Department of Immigration and Passports
organizations.description: Department responsible for issuing machine-readable and e-passports and visas and for immigration and border control services.

organizations.name: Minimum Wage Board
organizations.description: Board that recommends and publishes minimum wage rates for workers in declared industry sectors; linked from the Ministry of Labour and Employment website.

organizations.name: Bangladesh Crime Data (open-source project)
organizations.description: Independent GitHub project maintained by mahabub-rah that compiles the Bangladesh Police monthly crime statistics into machine-readable files and a public dashboard. Not an official source.

datasets.title: Crime Statistics by Police Unit (Annual)
datasets.description: Annual table of reported criminal cases by police unit (DMP, CMP and other metropolitan police and ranges, railway range), broken down by crime type: dacoity, robbery, murder, speedy trial, riot, woman and child repression, kidnapping, police assault, burglary, theft, other cases, and recovery cases (arms act, explosives, narcotics, smuggling). Tables were found for 2010-2019 and 2024; the pages for 2020-2023 showed 'No Data Found' at check time.
datasets.evidence_note: Page titled 'Crime Statistics 2024' shows an HTML table with columns Unit Name, Dacoity, Robbery, Murder, Speedy Trial, Riot, Woman & Child Repression, Kidnapping, ... Narcotics, Smuggling, Total; /year/2010 and /year/2019 also show tables.

datasets.title: Monthly Crime Statistics (Police Headquarters)
datasets.description: Monthly crime statistics statements issued by Police Headquarters (PHQ), listed with upload date and View/Download links. Each month (e.g. 'Crime Statistics, August-2026') is published as an image file.
datasets.evidence_note: 'List of Crime Statistics' table shows entries such as 'Crime Statistics, August-2026 - PHQ - 13-09-2026 - View Download', back to at least January-2025 on the first page, with pagination.

datasets.title: Bangladesh Crime Data: Monthly Cases by Police Unit (2019–2026)
datasets.description: Monthly case counts for every Metropolitan Police unit (DMP, CMP, KMP, RMP, BMP, SMP, RPMP, GMP) and police range, January 2019 to June 2026, by crime type: dacoity, robbery, murder, speedy trial, riot, woman and child repression, kidnapping, police assault, burglary, theft, other cases, recovery cases and total cases. The figures were extracted from the Bangladesh Police Headquarters monthly reports using the Gemini model, so check important figures against the official reports. The repository also has yearly SQL insert files and an interactive map dashboard.
datasets.evidence_note: Public repo (last push 2026-08-18) holds crime_data.csv with 1,530 rows (columns year, month, unit, dacoity … total_cases) covering January 2019 to June 2026, month_2019.sql–month_2026.sql, and a dashboard at mahabub-rah.github.io/Bangladesh-Crime-Data; README cites police.gov.bd monthly reports as the source; no license file.

datasets.title: 12th National Parliament Election Results by Constituency (2024)
datasets.description: Results of the 12th Jatiya Sangsad (national parliament) election, published as one Excel file per constituency for all 300 seats (e.g. 'Panchagarh-1 (seat no. 1) result').
datasets.evidence_note: Page 'দ্বাদশ জাতীয় সংসদ নির্বাচনের ফলাফল' lists 300 constituency rows each linking to an XLSX file (e.g. asset.ecs.gov.bd/.../2024/01/NPE_24_1.xlsx for পঞ্চগড়-১).

datasets.title: 11th National Parliament Election Centre-wise Results (2018)
datasets.description: Polling-centre-level results of the 11th national parliament election, arranged by seat in three Excel workbooks (seats 1-100, 101-198, 199-300). A gazette of the elected members for 298 seats is also provided as PDF.
datasets.evidence_note: Page lists 'একাদশ জাতীয় সংসদ নির্বাচনে আসন অনুযায়ী কেন্দ্রভিত্তিক ফলাফল (১ থেকে ১০০)', '(১০১ থেকে ১৯৮)', '(১৯৯ থেকে ৩০০)' as XLSX links and the 298-seat gazette as PDF.

datasets.title: 10th National Parliament Election Results (2014)
datasets.description: Results of the 10th national parliament election published in two Excel parts.
datasets.evidence_note: Row 4 'দশম জাতীয় সংসদ নির্বাচন-এর ফলাফল (১ম অংশ ও ২য় অংশ)' links to two XLSX files on asset.ecs.gov.bd.

datasets.title: City Corporation Election Results
datasets.description: Results of city corporation elections (mayor, general councillor and reserved women councillor) for Dhaka North, Dhaka South, Chattogram, Cumilla, Rangpur, Rajshahi, Sylhet, Khulna, Barishal, Narayanganj and others, from 2008 onward, mostly as Excel files with some PDFs; Cumilla 2022 has centre-wise results.
datasets.evidence_note: Page 'নির্বাচনি ফলাফল' lists items such as 'ঢাকা উত্তর সিটি কর্পোরেশন নির্বাচন ২০১৫-এর ফলাফল(মেয়র)' (.xlsx), 'বরিশাল সিটি কর্পোরেশন নির্বাচন ২০০৮-এর ফলাফল' (.xls) and 'কুমিল্লা সিটি কর্পোরেশন নির্বাচন ২০১২-এর ফলাফল' (.pdf).

datasets.title: 13th National Parliament Election and 2026 Referendum Results Portal
datasets.description: Interactive result search system linked from the Election Commission site, where users filter by result type, election type, election name, candidate type, district and seat to view results of the 13th national parliament election; a separate view shows 2026 referendum (gonovote) results.
datasets.evidence_note: ECS page links 'ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদ নির্বাচনের ফলাফল' to http://103.183.38.66:81/ and 'গণভোট ২০২৬ এর ফলাফল' to /gonovote/result; the loaded portal shows filters for result type, election type, election name, candidate type, district and seat.

datasets.title: Registered Voters by Division, District and Constituency
datasets.description: Interactive page showing registered voter totals, with male, female and hijra (third gender) breakdowns, filterable by division, district and electoral area; the national total was 127,711,899 voters at check time. The page also carries constituency map images.
datasets.evidence_note: Page 'নির্বাচনী এলাকা' has division/district/voter-area selectors and shows '১২,৭৭,১১,৮৯৯ মোট ভোটার, ৬,৪৮,২৫,১৫৪ মোট পুরুষ ভোটার, ৬,২৮,৮৫,৫২৫ মোট মহিলা ভোটার, ১,২২০ হিজড়া ভোটার'.

datasets.title: Parliamentary Constituency Delimitation Gazettes (2025-2026)
datasets.description: Official gazettes defining the boundaries of the 300 parliamentary constituencies, including the preliminary delimitation of July 2025, the final list of September 2025, the December 2025 gazette of all 300 redrawn seats, and later amendments after court cases.
datasets.evidence_note: Page 'নির্বাচনি এলাকা সংক্রান্ত গেজেট' lists '(নং-৮৭৫) জাতীয় সংসদের ৩০০ আসনের পুনঃনির্ধারিত সীমানার গেজেট (১১-১২-২০২৫)' and five other gazettes, each with a PDF 'ক্লিক করুন' link.

datasets.title: Polling Centre Gazettes for the 13th National Parliament Election
datasets.description: Gazette notifications listing polling centres, published as one PDF per constituency for the 13th national parliament election.
datasets.evidence_note: Page 'ত্রয়োদশ জাতীয় সংসদ নির্বাচনের কেন্দ্রসমূহের গেজেট' lists rows such as '১ পঞ্চগড়-১ এর কেন্দ্র সংক্রান্ত গেজেট - ডাউনলোড করুন' linking to PDFs.

datasets.title: List of Divisions, Districts, Upazilas, Unions, City Corporations and Municipalities
datasets.description: 'Bangladesh Organogram' web application linked from the Local Government Division site that lists the country's divisions, districts, upazilas and unions, as well as city corporations and paurashavas (municipalities), selectable step by step.
datasets.evidence_note: LGD homepage links 'বিভাগ,জেলা,উপজেলা,ইউনিয়ন' to http://180.211.161.250:93/Bangladesh, which loads 'বাংলাদেশের বিভাগ, জেলা, উপজেলা ও ইউনিয়ন সমূহের তালিকা' and 'সিটি কর্পোরেশন ও পৌরসভা সমূহের তালিকা'.

datasets.title: LGED Road and Growth Centre/Rural Market Database
datasets.description: Database of LGED-managed roads with national summary lengths by road type (upazila, union, village A and B roads) and surface (earthen, bituminous, RCC/CC, HBB, uni-block), bridge/culvert length and gap length, plus district/upazila road lists and a growth centre and rural market database.
datasets.evidence_note: Page shows 'Road Database as on November - 2025' with lengths for Upazila Road, Union Road, Village Road A/B and 'Total Roads: ... 411,043.31' km, a 'Table for Road List' district selector, and a 'Growth Center & Rural Market' tab.

datasets.title: LGED Digital Maps (District and Upazila)
datasets.description: Download page for LGED digital maps, selectable by district and upazila, which show local road and infrastructure networks.
datasets.evidence_note: Page 'Digital Map Download' with District and Upazila select lists covering all districts and upazilas.

datasets.title: LGED GIS Portal
datasets.description: Web GIS portal where users create customised road and other infrastructure maps from LGED GIS data; includes an analytical map of the upazila-level percentage of paved roads.
datasets.evidence_note: Page says 'Welcome to the GIS Portal of LGED. Create customized road and other infrastructure maps using our GIS data' and lists 'Analytical Map: Upazila Level % of Paved Road of Bangladesh'.

datasets.title: RHD Online Road Network (Highway Data and Traffic)
datasets.description: Online database of the RHD road network, summarising national, regional and zilla highways (998 roads, 22,736.58 km at check time), with road and link details, busiest links by annual average daily traffic (AADT), longest roads, and search by location and office.
datasets.evidence_note: Page shows 'Summary of Highways': National Highways 118 / 4,409.301 km, Regional 156 / 5,106.892 km, Zilla 724 / 13,220.387 km, and 'Busiest Links (top 10)' with AADT (e.g. N3-2, 217689).

datasets.title: RHD Bridge Management and Maintenance System (BMMS)
datasets.description: Internet version of the RHD Bridge Maintenance Management System for searching bridges and culverts on the RHD network by name, location, condition (A-D) and structure type. The site notes that the survey is incomplete and some data are under review.
datasets.evidence_note: Page 'Welcome to BMMS' shows 'No. of Bridges by condition A 12331, B 2341, C 2821, D 765' and 'No. of structures by type' (Box Culvert 9441, ...).

datasets.title: Number of Registered Motor Vehicles in Bangladesh (Year-wise)
datasets.description: Table of motor vehicles registered each year in Bangladesh by vehicle type (ambulance, auto rickshaw, bus, car, motorcycle, truck, etc.), from 'up to 2010' through each year to August 2026, with grand totals.
datasets.evidence_note: Page 'সারা বাংলাদেশে মোটরযান নিবন্ধনের সংখ্যা' has a PDF download; the PDF is titled 'NUMBER OF REGISTERED MOTOR VEHICLES IN BANGLADESH (YEARWISE)' with columns Upto-2010, 2011 ... 2025, Up To Aug-26.

datasets.title: Number of Registered Motor Vehicles in Dhaka (Year-wise)
datasets.description: Year-wise registrations of motor vehicles in the Dhaka metropolitan area by vehicle type, from 'up to 2010' to August 2026.
datasets.evidence_note: Page 'ঢাকা মেট্টোতে মোটরযান নিবন্ধনের সংখ্যা' has a PDF download titled 'NUMBER OF REGISTERED MOTOR VEHICLES IN DHAKA (YEARWISE)'.

datasets.title: BRTA Monthly Road Accident Reports
datasets.description: Monthly reports on road accidents compiled by BRTA, published as one PDF per month.
datasets.evidence_note: Page 'সড়ক দুর্ঘটনার মাসিক প্রতিবেদন' lists PDFs from 'জানুয়ারি, ২০২৩ মাসের সড়ক দুর্ঘটনার প্রতিবেদন' through 'অক্টোবর ২০২৫ মাসের সড়ক দুর্ঘটনার প্রতিবেদন'.

datasets.title: BRTA Annual Reports
datasets.description: Annual reports of the Bangladesh Road Transport Authority on its activities and services, covering fiscal years 2016-17 to 2022-23.
datasets.evidence_note: Page 'বার্ষিক প্রতিবেদন' lists 'বার্ষিক প্রতিবেদন ২০২২-২৩' down to 'বার্ষিক প্রতিবেদন ২০১৬-১৭', each with a PDF file.

datasets.title: Mobile Phone Subscribers by Operator (Monthly)
datasets.description: Monthly number of mobile subscribers (in millions) for Grameenphone, Robi Axiata, Banglalink and Teletalk, plus the total. A subscriber is defined as a biometric-verified subscription with activity in the preceding 90 days.
datasets.evidence_note: Page 'মোবাইল গ্রাহক' shows a table from 'আগস্ট ২০২১' to 'আগস্ট, ২০২৬' (latest total 191.09 million) with columns গ্রামীণফোন, রবি আজিয়াটা, বাংলালিংক, টেলিটক, মোট গ্রাহক (মিলিয়ন).

datasets.title: Internet Subscribers (Monthly)
datasets.description: Monthly number of internet subscribers (in millions), split into mobile internet and ISP + PSTN (fixed) internet, with the total. ISP/PSTN figures are updated quarterly.
datasets.evidence_note: Page 'ইন্টারনেট গ্রাহক' shows columns মোবাইল (মিলিয়ন), আইএসপি ও পিএসটিএন (মিলিয়ন), মোট গ্রাহক, latest 'আগস্ট, ২০২৬ ১২২.২৬ ১৫.৪০ ১৩৭.৬৬'.

datasets.title: Teledensity and Internet Penetration (Monthly)
datasets.description: Monthly teledensity (voice and internet subscriptions), total internet penetration, fixed broadband and mobile internet penetration, mobile broadband subscribers and penetration, and 3G and 4G subscriber counts.
datasets.evidence_note: Page 'টেলিডেনসিটি ও পেনেট্রেশন' shows monthly rows from আগস্ট ২০২১ to আগস্ট, ২০২৬ (e.g. teledensity 108.27%, internet penetration 77.89%).

datasets.title: Number of Telecom Towers by Operator (Monthly)
datasets.description: Monthly count of telecom towers owned by mobile network operators (GP, Robi, Banglalink, Teletalk), tower-sharing operators (edotco, Summit, Kirtonkhola, Frontier) and BTCL, with the total number of towers.
datasets.evidence_note: Page 'অপারেটর টাওয়ারের সংখ্যা' has a table from December 2022 to 'August, 2026' with Total Number of Towers 46,717.

datasets.title: Locally Manufactured Mobile Handsets (Monthly)
datasets.description: Monthly production of mobile handsets in Bangladesh (in lakh units) by technology (2G, 3G, 4G, 5G), with the share of feature phones and smartphones.
datasets.evidence_note: Page 'মোবাইল ফোন হ্যান্ডসেটের তথ্য' titled 'স্থানীয়ভাবে উৎপাদিত মোবাইল ফোন হ্যান্ডসেটের তথ্য' shows monthly rows from জানুয়ারি ২০২২ to আগস্ট, ২০২৬.

datasets.title: Chattogram Port Cargo, Container and Vessel Handling Statistics (Annual)
datasets.description: Annual statistics of cargo, container (TEU) and vessel handling at Chattogram Port, published as a scanned PDF.
datasets.evidence_note: Page 'কার্গো, কন্টেইনার ও জাহাজ হ্যান্ডলিং পরিসংখ্যানগত তথ্য (বার্ষিক)' offers a 6-page PDF (scanned) for download.

datasets.title: Chattogram Port Cargo, Container and Vessel Handling Statistics (Monthly)
datasets.description: Month-by-month import, export and total cargo (metric tonnes), containers (TEUs) and number of vessels handled at Chattogram Port during the current year.
datasets.evidence_note: Page 'কার্গো, কন্টেইনার ও জাহাজ হ্যান্ডলিং পরিসংখ্যানগত তথ্য (মাসিক)' links a PDF titled 'CARGO, CONTAINER & VESSEL HANDLING DURING 2026' with January-July figures.

datasets.title: Chittagong Port Authority Annual Reports
datasets.description: Annual reports of the Chittagong Port Authority for fiscal years 2015-16 to 2023-24.
datasets.evidence_note: Page 'বার্ষিক প্রতিবেদন' lists 'বার্ষিক প্রতিবেদন ২০২৩-২০২৪' through 'বার্ষিক প্রতিবেদন ২০১৫-২০১৬' with PDF files.

datasets.title: Railway Information Book
datasets.description: Annual information book on Bangladesh Railway, published by the Ministry of Railways; editions for 2019, 2020, 2021 and 2022 are available as PDFs.
datasets.evidence_note: Page 'রেলওয়ে ইনফরমেশন বুক' lists 'রেলওয়ে ইনফরমেশন বুক (২০১৯)', '(২০২০)', '(২০২১)', '(২০২২)' with PDF download links.

datasets.title: CAAB Annual Report 2023-24
datasets.description: Annual report (in Bangla) of the Civil Aviation Authority of Bangladesh for FY 2023-24, describing its organisation, activities and airport development projects such as terminal and cargo complex expansion.
datasets.evidence_note: CAAB homepage links 'বার্ষিক প্রতিবেদন' to http://new.caab.gov.bd/devlpmnts/Annual%20Report%202023-24.pdf, which resolved to a 30-page PDF.

datasets.title: Statistics of Government Servants
datasets.description: Annual statistical publication from the Ministry of Public Administration's Statistics and Research Cell on government employees in the civil service. Editions for 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025 were listed.
datasets.evidence_note: The 'বই ও ম্যানুয়ল' list includes 'সরকারি কর্মচারীদের পরিসংখ্যান, ২০২৫' (13/08/2026), '... ২০২৪', 'STATISTICS OF GOVERNMENT SERVANTS 2023' and '... ২০২২', each from পরিসংখ্যান ও গবেষণা কোষ with a PDF.

datasets.title: Ministry of Public Administration Annual Reports
datasets.description: Annual reports of the Ministry of Public Administration for fiscal years 2018-19 to 2022-23.
datasets.evidence_note: The list shows 'জনপ্রশাসন মন্ত্রণালয়ের বার্ষিক প্রতিবেদন ২০২২-২০২৩' back to 'বার্ষিক প্রতিবেদন ২০১৮-১৯', each with a PDF file.

datasets.title: Supreme Court of Bangladesh Annual Reports (with Case Statistics)
datasets.description: Annual reports of the Supreme Court for 2007 to 2024. The 2024 report includes statistics of new filings, disposals and pending cases in the Appellate Division, along with other information about the courts.
datasets.evidence_note: 'Annual Reports' page lists 'Annual Report of 2024' through 'Annual Report of 2007' linking to resources/contents/Annual_Report_YYYY.pdf; the 2024 PDF has a section 'Statistics of New Filing, Disposal and Pending Cases in the Appellate Division'.

datasets.title: Overseas Employment and Remittances by Destination Country (2004 onward)
datasets.description: Year-by-destination-country table of Bangladeshi workers sent abroad (KSA, UAE, Kuwait, Oman, Qatar, Bahrain, Lebanon, Jordan, Libya, Sudan, Malaysia, Singapore, S. Korea, UK, Italy, Japan, Egypt, Brunei, Mauritius, Iraq, others), miscellaneous clearances, total employment and remittance inflow in million USD (remittance sourced from Bangladesh Bank), 2004 to May 2025, with charts. Published as an image table on a BMET statistics page.
